claims.claim_text: The capitalist class depends on the labor of working people.
Capitalism endows the working class with enormous potential power.
Workers have the power to stop production and the flow of profits.
Workers have the power to create a political crisis when public employees strike.
The working class, as the overwhelming majority of society, has the capacity to overturn the political system that protects capitalist power.

Ending capitalism requires mobilizing the working class's power to stop production and profits, create political crises through public-employee strikes, and overturn the political system protecting capitalist power.
Organizing the working class as workers is central to questions of strategy for ending capitalism.
Capitalism stokes racial oppression to keep working people divided and to justify exploitation.
Capitalism stokes national oppression to keep working people divided and to justify exploitation.
Capitalism stokes gender oppression to keep working people divided and to justify exploitation.
Capitalism creates intense competition for jobs, housing, and decent schools.
Capitalism pits workers against each other.
Capitalism makes prejudiced ideas seem plausible.
Socialists are committed to ending all forms of oppression as part of their vision of winning a truly free society.
Socialists strive to build a united multiracial working-class movement.
